reports.notes: Born-digital fillable form; figures typed. Street address, city and signature are redacted upstream by the county (black bars), so residence_city is ''. Office prints as 'Sheriff' and agrees with index.csv's 'County Sheriff'. Date box, Date of Filing and the summary page's Date of Report all read 05/09/2022. This revision labels the close box 'G' and prints no 'v.' version string. TWO SUMMARY PAGES WERE FLAGGED (4 and 5) but page 5 is the county's internal Campaign Financial Disclosure Checklist (staff-reviewed 5/18/2022 twice), not a second report - this 6-page PDF holds ONE report.

contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' on the p4 Summary Page, a typed bare '0'; corroborated by Schedule A's OWN two printed footers, 'Subtotal for this page $ 0' and 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of all Schedule A Pages in this report) $ 0'
contributions.detail: The Schedule A page EXISTS at p2 and is wholly unmarked: all fifteen printed rows are blank in every one of the five columns (Date / Name of Contributor / City and State / Amount / In-Kind) and no In-Kind box is ticked. Zero rows therefore sum to 0.00, which equals all three printed figures. Each of those three is a TYPED numeral '0', not a dash and not an empty cell, so under the repo zero-glyph ruling it denotes zero — this is a real absence of entries (empty-schedule), NOT an unread side and NOT a document that lacks the page. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' prints 10,778.00 and is the CUMULATIVE cell: it is never summed as an increment, and it happens to equal this filer's previous report's period figure because that report was his first of the cycle.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' (1,359.27) on the p4 Summary Page, which is also Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' (1359.27) AND its printed 'Total Expenditures Made — Sum of all Schedule B Pages in this report' (1359.27)
expenditures.detail: The 8 Schedule B rows on p3 sum to 61.20 + 50 + 24.67 + 93.48 + 269.92 + 50 + 410 + 400 = 1,359.27 exactly, equal to all three printed figures. The page-subtotal gate and the sum-of-all-pages gate agree because Schedule B is a single sheet. Box E 'Expenditures Made Year to Date' prints 10,064.77 and is CUMULATIVE — never summed as an increment. The summary ladder is internally consistent: Box F 2,072.50 = Box A 2,072.50 + Box B 0, and Box G 713.23 = Box F 2,072.50 − Box D 1,359.27.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only, and the expenditure side closes on it exactly (1,359.27). BOTH conventions were tested and they are IDENTICAL on this filing because NO in-kind is claimed anywhere on it. This is the NEWER unversioned 2022 blank, which DOES carry a fifth 'In-Kind' checkbox column on both schedules — so the ADDENDUM J1 hazard is live here and was handled as J1 requires: the Amount and In-Kind cells were cropped TOGETHER AS ONE BLOCK (rows 1-4 and rows 5-8 of Schedule B) and the pairing read from that single image rather than from vertical position. Every one of the 8 checkboxes renders EMPTY beside its own amount, and the empty Schedule A's 15 boxes are empty too. Note for the wave: on THIS filing the checkbox sits inside its own row's band (high within the box but not crossing into the row above), so the J1 half-row displacement did not bite — but that was established by the joint crop, not assumed.

Every ADDENDUM J1 discriminator is present on this one and was read off the page: the Schedule A column headings are Date / Name of Contributor / 'CITY AND STATE' (not 'Address and Zip Code') / Amount / a fifth 'IN-KIND' CHECKBOX column; the close box is LETTERED 'G'; the cover offers SIX report types (End-of-Year is added); the cover foliates 'Date of Filing' and the sheets carry NO Page field at all, so this filing is UNFOLIATED; and there is no version string in the footer. The Schedule B here also carries the In-Kind column, which the v. 4.20 Schedule B does not.

SIX PDF PAGES = FIVE SHEETS. p1 cover / p2 Schedule A (blank) / p3 Schedule B / p4 SUMMARY PAGE / p5 CAMPAIGN FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE CHECKLIST / p6 BLANK VERSO. Every page classified from its own printed header.

THIS FILING IS THE OTHER HALF OF THE REGISTERED 'utah-checklist-decoy' CONTROL PAIR, AND THE PAIR IS CONFIRMED — with a correction to how it is usually described. Its p5 IS the checklist (recites every summary-page label, carries ZERO dollar figures, born-digital clean against photocopy-degraded report pages) while the SAME FILER'S 4/1/2022 filing has a GENUINE SUMMARY PAGE at its p5. So the trap is real and is exactly 'same ordinal, different page kind'. BUT: the 4/1/2022 filing ALSO binds a checklist, at its p7. The pair is therefore NOT 'one filing has a checklist and the other does not' — BOTH filings bind one, at different ordinals, and only content tells them apart. Both CHECKLIST REVISIONS appear inside this one filer's own cycle: this filing's p5 is the PLAIN revision (a 'Website / Network' box, one unnumbered 'Staff Signature' per copy, signed 5/18/2022 in blue and 5/18/22 in red), while 4/1/2022's p7 is the revision with the added 'HOLD' line and numbered 'Staff Signature #1 / #2'.

CONTRIBUTIONS ARE AN HONEST ZERO, NOT AN UNREAD SIDE. The Schedule A page exists, is printed, and the filer entered nothing on it; the three printed zeros (both schedule footers and Box B) are typed numerals. A future reader must not take this as 'no donors were transcribed'.

CROSS-FILING CONTINUITY, RECORDED AS OBSERVATION ONLY AND NOT USED AS A GATE (no two covers were differenced): Box A 2,072.50 equals the closing balance printed on this filer's 4/1/2022 report, and Box E 10,064.77 equals that report's stated Box D 8,705.50 plus this report's 1,359.27. That second identity is relevant to the +0.01 delta recorded on 966dbc38: the filer's own cumulative ladder carries HIS 8,705.50, which is consistent with the cent being his arithmetic rather than a misread of a row — but the rows on that filing were still not nudged, and this observation was not used to change any figure here or there.
